text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the rims on 'Iron Tail' are simply 
gorgeous after all. The black spokes also 
give off such a sense of power.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With this, I should be able to run long 
distances without worry... Oh, if I order 
now, it looks like it'll arrive in time 
for the weekend.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then a long ride along the coastline, or 
perhaps crossing a mountain pass? Ngh, 
what a dilemma...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case—we'll adjust the schedule and 
run in both! This is where my skills will 
truly shine.
